November, 2023
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh

In The High Court At Calcutta

In the matter of : Diwakar Prasad Sharma @ Dibakar Sharma
 ... Petitioner.
 Mr. Pawan Kumar Gupta,
 Ms. Sofia Nesar,
 Mr. Santanu Sett ... For the Petitioner.
 Mr. Arijit Ganguly ...
Learned advocate appearing for the petitioner is  directed to serve a copy of this revisional application upon  Mr. Arijit Ganguly, learned advocate, who ordinarily appears  for the State.
His appointment may be regularised by the  concerned authorities.

The petitioner is also directed to serve copy of this  revisional application upon the opposite party no.2 by Speed  Post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit-of-service  on the next date fixed for hearing.

Mr. Gupta, learned advocate appearing for the  petitioner has drawn the attention of the Court to the fact  that earlier the opposite party no.2 has initiated FIR being  BST Women Police Station Case No. 27 of 2020 dated Diwakar Prasad Sharma @ Dibakar Sharma vs Unknown on 18 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174334022/

sentences.text:
. Another FIR was registered at the instance of the  opposite party no.2 being Dum Dum Police Station Case No.
 684 of 2020 dated 09.10.2020 under Sections 498A/494 of  the Indian Penal Code.
The opposite party no.2 again lodged  FIR under Sections 498A/325/506 of the Indian Penal Code  2 being Dum Dum Police Station Case No. 547 of 2021 dated 06.05.2021 .
The last of the FIR as well as the charge-sheet is under challenge before this Court.

Having considered the submissions so advanced by the learned advocate for the petitioner and the documents enclosed along with the present revisional application, I am of the view that this revisional application is required to be heard out on merits.
Accordingly, list the revisional application under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of March 2024.

Pending hearing of this revisional application, all further proceedings relating to Dum Dum Police Station Case No. 547 of 2021 dated 06.05.2021 before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barrackpore be stayed till 31.03.2024.
Learned advocate for the State would produce the case diary on the next date so fixed.
All concerned parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
